name: nyra
description: Nyra — Telegram AI bot on Cloudflare Workers

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: REQUIRED — your Telegram bot token from @BotFather (format `123456789:AA...`). Get it: message @BotFather → /mybots → your bot → API Token.

ADMIN_IDS.description: REQUIRED — numeric Telegram user ID(s) of the administrator(s), digits only (e.g. `123456789`), comma-separated for several. Find yours by sending any message to @userinfobot.
